checks: SummaryMetrics remains a semantic section using the shared Metric and mg-metric-grid primitives.
The metric band is outside the shared mg-hero secondary column and has width: 100% with min-width: 0.
The existing billing data, actions, mutation flow, and loading/permission/error states are preserved.
git diff --check passed for the owned source files.

failure_origin: AdminBillingPage.module.css applied min-width: 520px to the metric band while the shared mg-hero secondary grid track was capped at 250-330px.

commands.detail: Figma MCP tool was not available; preflight reported figma_mcp_not_available.

finding_fixed.change: Kept the title and refresh action in mg-hero, and moved SummaryMetrics into the page-prelude as a full-width sibling region.
Added a minmax-constrained page prelude and removed the 520px metric minimum; the metric band now fills its own responsive region with min-width: 0.

responsive_reasoning: At 1440px and 1280px, the metric section is no longer constrained by the mg-hero 250-330px secondary track, so the shared four-column mg-metric-grid can give each card a stable readable width.
At 1024px, the shared primitive changes the metric grid to two minmax(0, 1fr) columns at max-width 1120px, avoiding four compressed cards.
At 390px, the shared primitive changes to one column at max-width 760px; width: 100% and min-width: 0 prevent horizontal growth while preserving each metric's label, value, icon, and detail.
unverified_items: Authenticated browser geometry, screenshots, console output, and interaction verification at 1440px, 1280px, 1024px, and 390px were not run in this bounded lane.
Figma node-level synchronization and visual audit were not run because the required MCP tool was unavailable.
Release, deployment, and production readback were not run.
